d3cbcf8a420d7c31.title: Evidence Accumulation in Synaptic Efficacy: Activity-Silent Decision-Making with Short-Term Plasticity
digest: Decision-making requires accumulation of evidence over time, yet exactly how neural circuits implement this computation remains debated.

Classical models posit that evidence accumulation is realized by ramping neural activity, whereas recent experimental findings suggest an alternative mechanism in which neural activity remains largely silent before abruptly transitioning into an active decision state.
